articles.headline: June’s CPI Report Just Changed The Rate Debate: Here's What Investors Should Watch
articles.summary:
June’s inflation report delivered a pleasant surprise, with the annual CPI rate falling to 3.5%. 



The data was released just hours before new Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh’s first congressional testimony, giving
articles._summary: June’s inflation report delivered a pleasant surprise, with the annual CPI rate falling to 3.5%. The data was released just hours before new Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh’s first congressional testimony, giving investors fresh insight into how the Fed’s policy outlook could evolve from here. Strip out food and energy, and there was zero inflation last month. That’s the number that matters most for what happens next. One day before this report, Fed Governor Waller warned that a hot core print could force the FOMC to consider hiking. Well, the report came in flat instead, meaning that the hawkish case is now effectively off the table. The flat core print is the first genuinely clean signal in months that underlying price pressures are breaking, rather than just easing on the back of temporary swings in energy costs.

articles._zh_summary: 6月通胀报告令人惊喜，CPI年率回落至3.5%。该数据是在美联储新任主席凯文·沃什首次在国会作证前几个小时发布的，让投资者对美联储的政策前景如何演变有了新的了解。除去食品和能源，上个月通胀为零。这是对接下来发生的事情最重要的数字。在这份报告发布前一天，美联储理事沃勒警告称，一份热门的核心报告可能会迫使联邦公开市场委员会考虑加息。然而，该报告的结果却持平，这意味着鹰派的观点现在实际上已经不被讨论了。扁平核心打印是几个月来第一个真正明确的信号，表明潜在的价格压力正在突破，而不仅仅是因能源成本暂时波动而缓解。
